title: Honolulu Judo Club

services.name: Judo Gi
services.desc: Judo Fundamentals: Beginner & intermediate oriented classes that teach the fundamentals of Olympic Judo that are fun, inclusive and build a strong mind and body. Judo Essentials: Classes for beginners through advanced level players that teach essential judo skills and prepare them for competition at the local and national levels. This class is closed during judo season (Feb-Apr). Back to Basics Judo: Focuses on the finer points of basic fundamental technique, as well as conditioning exercises to build the strength and flexibility to execute them. For security purposes, we currently do not offer online registration. Please download and complete all forms and bring them to the dojo to sign
